<thought>Search the template catalog using only the functional group criteria (break aliphatic carboxylic acid, form amide) to find a suitable retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
